subject: Workplace Skills
title: Emotional Intelligence in Leadership
description: A short lesson to help you apply Emotional Intelligence in Leadership.

hook.text: Daniel Goleman found emotional intelligence accounts for 90% of what distinguishes top leaders from average ones.

buildup.text: EQ has four parts: self-awareness, self-regulation, empathy, and social skill. IQ gets you hired; EQ gets you promoted.

discovery.text: Self-awareness is the foundation. Leaders who know their triggers can manage reactions instead of being controlled.

twist.text: High-IQ leaders who lack EQ often micromanage, shut down dissent, and lose top talent. Brains without EQ repel people.

climax.text: Practice the pause: when triggered, count to three before responding. That gap turns reactions into thoughtful responses.

punchline.text: Pause before reacting. EQ is built in the gap.

quiz.question: What is the foundation of emotional intelligence in leadership?
options: Self-awareness of your own triggers and reactions
